name: Stelrad Group PLC
summary: Stelrad Group PLC is a key player in the production and supply of radiators, with operations spanning the United Kingdom, Ireland, various European countries, Turkey, and other global markets. The company provides a diverse array of heating solutions, which include steel panel radiators, low surface temperature models, towel warmers, decorative steel tubular designs, and other steel column radiator types. These products are distributed under their established brand names: Stelrad, Henrad, Termo Teknik, and Hudevad. The company, which traces its origins back to 1936, is headquartered in Newcastle Upon Tyne, United Kingdom.
